Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 22, 2026

This policy covers the SYNQ Studios website (synqstudios815.com) and SYNQ Poster, an internal tool SYNQ Studios uses to upload short video clips to its own YouTube channel.

SYNQ Poster and YouTube API Services

SYNQ Poster uses YouTube API Services. It is not a public app: it runs only on our own computer and is used only by SYNQ Studios to publish videos we made to the YouTube channel we own and manage. By using YouTube features through this tool you are also bound by the YouTube Terms of Service, and Google's handling of data is described in the Google Privacy Policy.

What data SYNQ Poster accesses

  • An OAuth access token for our own YouTube channel, so the tool can upload videos and read the channel's name to confirm it is posting to the right channel.
  • The videos, titles and descriptions we choose to upload.

SYNQ Poster does not access, collect or store data about any other YouTube users or viewers.

How it is stored and shared

The access token is stored only on our own computer, in a private file. We do not sell, share or transfer any data obtained through YouTube API Services to anyone else, and we do not use it for advertising.

Revoking access

Access can be revoked at any time from the Google account's security settings at myaccount.google.com/permissions. When access is revoked, we delete the stored token.

This website

The website uses GoatCounter for simple, cookie-free visit counts. Bookings are handled by Square, under Square's own privacy policy. We do not collect personal data on this site ourselves.

Contact
